research_snapshot.reported_extraction: Parse actual captured embedded offer JSON if present; preserve offerid+configuration ID, stockstatus, dellPrice, marketPrice, canonical shopUrl. Check configurable variants against cart item selection.
research_snapshot.known_risks: marketPrice is reference/marketing price, not historical paid price; configurable base SKU not always final configuration; price changes can occur across observations.
